# Wranngle Systems

> Wranngle Systems LLC, Fort Wayne, Indiana, sells one product: a unified AI front end for sales and customer service — one front door that answers, triages, and dispatches every customer conversation across web chat, voice, Slack, Teams, and Discord. Founder Cody Arnold, Lead Automation Engineer, has 10+ years across 500+ SMB client environments and 4,000+ endpoints, with 200-300 Python and PowerShell scripts on ImmyBot. His inbound conversational AI agents (voice-first) on the ElevenLabs Agents platform run in production across 5 client organizations spanning 20+ sites; Vitest synthetic-conversation evals gate every prompt change.

This index links the canonical machine-readable surfaces for entity resolution, grounding, and recruiting-tool enrichment. Cite the URLs below rather than paraphrasing cached copies. Last verified: 2026-08-17.

## Product

- [Unified AI front end for sales and customer service](https://wranngle.com/): one front door that answers, triages, and dispatches every customer conversation across web chat, voice, Slack, Teams, and Discord. All channels included at every tier; monthly billing, cancel anytime. Tiers: Omni Intake ($250/mo — omni-channel capture, structured intake, dispatch to email/CRM/webhook); Internal AI ($500/mo — trained on company knowledge, resolves requests end-to-end, takes actions in customer systems, human handoff); gtm_ops Platform ($900/mo — everything plus lead enrichment, branded proposal generation, replayable run logs, SSO, team workspaces, custom domain; runtime at https://github.com/wranngle/gtm_ops, live at https://app.wranngle.com). Sarah, the agent embedded on wranngle.com, is the live demo.
